descriptionChirho: A fractional unit of dry measure equal to one-tenth of an ephah, used almost exclusively in cultic grain-offering prescriptions (Lev 14:10, Num 15:4, 28:5). The singular עִשָּׂרוֹן (eng: tenth, spa: décima, arb: عُشْرٍ, kor: 십분의–일, swa: ya-kumi) and plural עֶשְׂרֹנִים (eng: tenths, spa: décimas, hin: दसवें–भाग, arb: أَعْشَارٍ, swa: za-kumi) are grammatical inflections of the same measurement noun, not distinct senses.
